content: पुर {%a.%} [पृ-क] Full of, filled with. .{@-रम्@} .²1 A town, city (containing large buildings, surrounded by a ditch, and not less than one Krośa in extent); पुरे तावन्तमेवास्य तनोति रविरातपम् <ls>Ku. 2. 33</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 59</ls>. .²2 A castle, fortress, stronghold. .²3 A house, residence, abode. .²4 The body; नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन् न कारयन् <ls>Bg. 5. 13</ls>. .²5 The female apartments. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the town पाटलिपुत्र; <ab>q. v.</ab> .²7 The calyx of a flower, or any cup formed of leaves. .²8 A brothel. .²9 The skin. .²10 Bdellium. .²11 An upper story. .²12 A store-house. .²13 A fragrant grass (नागरमुस्ता).
